headline: 15-Year-Old's Quick Action Saves Neighbour's Life
meta_description: A 15-year-old from Nottinghamshire performed hundreds of chest compressions to revive an unconscious neighbour. The patient is now recovering.
summary_short: Ethan, 15, from Nottinghamshire performed up to 800 chest compressions in six minutes, helping save a neighbour who was unconscious and not breathing.
body:
A 15-year-old named Ethan from Nottinghamshire performed up to 800 chest compressions in six minutes, helping to revive a neighbour who had become unconscious and stopped breathing.

The quick thinking and physical endurance required to maintain such intensive CPR during a medical emergency highlights how training in first aid can make the difference between life and death. Ethan's sustained effort throughout those critical six minutes may well have been the deciding factor in the outcome.

The neighbour is now recovering, a testament to both Ethan's decisive action and the power of community members equipped with basic life-saving skills. The incident serves as a reminder of the importance of young people learning CPR and remaining calm during emergencies.
